title: campanula rotundifolia subsp. pennina
intro: Campanula rotundifolia subsp. pennina, commonly known as Heath Bellflower, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the bellflower family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe and calm various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Campanula rotundifolia subsp. pennina include its ability to act as a demulcent, providing protective and soothing effects on mucous membranes, as well as its potential to act as a spasmolytic, relaxing smooth muscle and reducing spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
